cardOverview.overviewText: The HSBC Privé Credit Card is an invite-only, ultra-premium card for HSBC’s Global Private Banking clients in India with over USD 2 million in assets. Issued in partnership with Mastercard, it offers global lounge access, companion First/Business Class tickets, zero forex markup, personal concierge with doorstep visa services, and access to exclusive clubs and luxury experiences worldwide, making it one of India’s most prestigious and selective credit cards.
